insights.title: 47% of trades die within 2 bars
insights.detail: 656/1405 trades exit via STOP_LOSS or FAIL_FAST within 2 bars. These are entries that immediately move against the position.

insights.title: Underperformer: S7/15m (29% WR)
insights.detail: S7/15m: WR=28.9% vs overall 41.4% (N=277, Wilson 95% CI: (0.2386, 0.3448)). Avg R=-0.6, total PnL=-725.29. Decomposition: avg_win=8.1, avg_loss=-6.97.

insights.title: Underperformer: Sunday (26% WR)
insights.detail: Sunday: WR=26.4% vs overall 41.4% (N=140, Wilson 95% CI: (0.1982, 0.3429)). Avg R=-0.551, total PnL=-862.97. Decomposition: avg_win=11.63, avg_loss=-12.56.

insights.title: MAE/MFE data not available — bar-by-bar tracking needed
insights.detail: trace_json stores entry-time features only, not intra-trade bar tracking. Adding MAE/MFE would enable stop optimization (are stops too tight? too loose?) and target calibration. Implementation: ~30 lines in opportunity_simulator.py:611-676.

insights.title: Best winner rule: exit.bars_held <= 2.5 AND ind.rsi <= 80.1003
insights.detail: Decision tree path [exit.bars_held <= 2.5 AND ind.rsi <= 80.1003 AND ind.rsi_sma <= 54.4845 AND ind.sma200_slope_atr > -0.0752] → 27% win rate on 243 trades. vs population 41.4%.

insights.title: High stop-loss rule: score.break_strength > 0.9283 AND ind.rsi > 73.4134
insights.detail: Path [score.break_strength > 0.9283 AND ind.rsi > 73.4134 AND ind.ma_gap_atr <= 2.9508] → 85% stop-loss rate on 39 trades.

insights.title: Worst archetype: 'Mixed Quick-Death (S6)' (38% WR)
insights.detail: Cluster 2 (213 trades): WR=37.6%, avg R=-0.28, dominant setup=S6, exit=FAIL_FAST. Top features: ind.rsi(z=2.07), state.htf_bias_score(z=2.06), ind.ema50_slope_atr(z=1.94).

insights.title: Best archetype: 'Winners Target-Hit (S6)' (75% WR)
insights.detail: Cluster 1 (12 trades): WR=75.0%, avg R=0.19, dominant setup=S6, exit=TP1. Top features: ind.sma_200(z=10.75), ind.ema_50(z=10.75), ind.bb_ub(z=10.75).

insights.title: TP2 hit rate: 6% of profitable exits reach TP2
insights.detail: Of 397 trades exiting at a target, 24 (6%) reached TP2. TP1: 373, TP2: 24.

insights.title: Top predictor of STOP_LOSS: score.clean_close
insights.detail: score.clean_close correlates with STOP_LOSS exit (rho=0.277, p=0.0, N=1405).

insights.title: Top predictor of FAIL_FAST: exit.bars_held
insights.detail: exit.bars_held correlates with FAIL_FAST exit (rho=-0.2462, p=0.0, N=1405).

insights.title: Top predictor of TP1: state.long_allowed
insights.detail: state.long_allowed correlates with TP1 exit (rho=0.3111, p=0.068911, N=35).

insights.title: Top predictor of TP2: score.break_strength
insights.detail: score.break_strength correlates with TP2 exit (rho=-0.1183, p=0.017407, N=404).

insights.title: Top predictor of TRAIL_STOP: score.severity
insights.detail: score.severity correlates with TRAIL_STOP exit (rho=0.5118, p=0.017696, N=21).

insights.title: Top predictor of TIME_STOP: state.squeeze_age
insights.detail: state.squeeze_age correlates with TIME_STOP exit (rho=0.5565, p=0.008785, N=21).

insights.title: Top positive correlate with pnl_net: state.bias_score
insights.detail: state.bias_score has rho=0.4938 (p=0.022909, N=21) with pnl_net. Higher values predict better outcomes.

insights.title: Top negative correlate with pnl_net: score.conv_tight
insights.detail: score.conv_tight has rho=-0.1912 (p=0.512584, N=14) with pnl_net. Higher values predict worse outcomes.
